0: NIKÍTA [ shakes her off ] Leave me alone! And you, father, hear me! And first, Marína, look here! [ Bows to the ground to her and rises ] I have sinned towards you! I promised to marry you, I tempted you, and forsook you! Forgive me, in Christ's name! [ Again bows to the ground before her ]. ANÍSYA. And what are you drivelling about? It's not becoming! No one wants to know! Get up! It's like your impudence!
